definitions.point_assignment: display_from_frame <= impact_source_frame < next_display_from_frame; last interval has no upper bound
definitions.point_interval_gaps: Allowed, but every one of the 80 events must match exactly one interval; overlapping intervals forbidden
definitions.front_pair_won_point: front_pair == point_winner; nullable boolean; unknown remains blank, excluded from A/B/D only
definitions.order_and_last: Chronological impact order among the 80 labeled events in each point; last is not necessarily the actual final stroke
definitions.d: signed_displacement_toward_actual_court_width; positive toward actual ball direction; unit=court width
definitions.movement: toward: d >= 0.015; away: d <= -0.015; stay: abs(d) < 0.015
definitions.baseline: All outcome-known events pooled, event-weighted; not a point-weighted win rate
definitions.binomial_ci: Two-sided Clopper-Pearson 95%; assumes independent events (not cluster-adjusted)
definitions.fisher: Two-sided, rows=toward/away, columns=front win/loss; undefined if any margin is zero; repeated within each timepoint's category rows
definitions.holm: Four-timepoint families separately for A and D, including undefined tests in family size; no additional B/C adjustment
definitions.mannwhitney: Two-sided asymptotic, tie-corrected, continuity correction; event-level reference p, not cluster-adjusted; same as 101
definitions.outcome_auc: P(d_won > d_lost) + 0.5*P(equal), pooled across eligible events including within-point event pairs
definitions.v: d if actual_direction_target_front_view == front_right else -d; checked against lateral displacement and near/far orientation
definitions.direction_auc: P(v_actual_right > v_actual_left) + 0.5*P(equal), same estimator and all 80 events as 101
definitions.bootstrap: G actual represented eligible points drawn G times uniformly with replacement; keep all events and duplicated draws; pooled event-weighted AUC; percentile CI with numpy linear quantile; omit and count one-class replicates
definitions.bootstrap_rng: numpy.default_rng(20261117), PCG64; B times [-0.5,-0.3,-0.2,-0.1] then C same order, one sequential stream
definitions.previous_direction_ci: Read main80 rows from 101 threshold_free.csv, estimated gap600 clusters; not recomputed or overwritten
definitions.partition_comparison: Reconstruct 101's frame-gap clusters on the same 80 events; compare point-to-estimated and estimated-to-point memberships, not just counts

limitations: Events within a point are not independent
Point winner may be determined by many later strokes; no causal inference
Adding outcome does not identify feints or return-to-origin motions; d is retrospective
